summary: The TypeScript fixed-output installation uses a semantic inputsHash instead of the whole effect-utils source hash, allowing unrelated upstream and root changes to reuse the installation while real installation changes fail closed.

replay.detail: Packaging only; no graph, replay or storage change.

schema.detail: The Fractal-owned nix/typescript-client-deps.hash pin now records schemaVersion 1, a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 inputsHash and the measured SRI output hash.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Installation names and guards use the full semantic inputsHash. Identity includes selected staged source bytes, transitive local source dependencies, the staging helper closure, installation recipe and builder/toolchain inputs across supported systems. Consumers no longer have to match the whole effect-utils narHash; Fractal remains the pin owner. The full TypeScript check is unchanged.

manual.detail: Run scripts/nix-typescript-client-deps-hash after changing installation inputs. It reads the identity before forcing the guard, builds only the installation and atomically replaces the schema/identity/output pin, restoring original bytes on failure or interruption. Network and a builder for the selected system are required.

recovery.detail: Revert the installation identity implementation and its pin together to restore the previous packaging contract.
